description: Where each Phase-1 roster modality's V-class facts get verified: the guideline or manual ReConnect cites, resolved to a current document and URL, and ONE PubMed-confirmed key RCT, meta-analysis or Cochrane review for the modality's primary indication. The therapies analogue of pharmacy/label_sources.json and screening_tools/custodian_sources.json. Every keyEvidencePmid was confirmed through PubMed on the generated date; a null means PubMed does not index the paper, never a guess. evidenceType 'cohort-comparison' marks the one entry (Safety Planning Intervention, Stanley 2018) whose key evidence is not randomized. DRAFT until G0-E.
